name: soft-report
description: Basic Electron desktop application template with Node.js and TypeScript.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on dist/main.js dist/preload.js dist/renderer.js && nodemon --watch dist --watch index.html --ext js,html --exec electron .
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n TSC,ELECTRON -c yellow,cyan "npm run watch" "npm run dev:electron"
